page.title: Career path
page.description: Your path in your job title, in five sections in the same order: description, evaluation, development, learning and required.
page.notReady: Your career path is not ready yet
page.notReadyHint: HR prepares it for your title, and it appears here as soon as it is ready.
page.loadFailed: Your career path could not be loaded. Try again.

evaluation.note: Performance evaluation belongs to your development stage, not to the title. Its weights, criteria and grade scale appear here when an evaluation cycle opens.

development.certificates: Certificates at the end of the level
development.ladderHint: You climb from left to right: each grade is higher than the one before it.
development.stageLabel: Development stage (from the grade and track)
development.pathNote: «Applied at work» is approved by your direct manager and then by the development officer before it counts.
development.competenciesNote: «Basic» and «Expert» are the levels of a competency; «—» means the competency is not part of that level.

learning.noMatches: No units match the search and filters.

required.whileInPeriod: While you are in the period

gate.intro: Read the five sections of your path in order (description, evaluation, development, learning, required). You move from one section to the next with «Next» after scrolling to its end, then reach the «Acknowledgement» step. You cannot use the rest of the platform before you acknowledge.
gate.stepsLabel: Steps of reading the path in order
gate.locked: Opens after you read the previous section
gate.lockedToast: Read the sections in order: press «Next» after scrolling to the end of each one.
gate.scrollHint: Scroll to the end of the section to enable «Next»
gate.ackStepDone: You finished the five sections. One step is left: the acknowledgement.
gate.ackStepHint: Tick the acknowledgement box in the bar below, then press «Acknowledge and continue». You can go back to any section with «Previous».
gate.ackDefault: I have read my career path and acknowledge it
gate.ackRecorded: The acknowledgement is recorded with your name, content version {{version}} and the date.
gate.ackLocked: Enabled after you read the five sections in order and reach the acknowledgement step.
gate.done: Acknowledged. You can keep using the platform.
gate.stale: The content of your path changed while you were reading. Reload the page and read the new version.
gate.failed: The acknowledgement could not be recorded. Try again.

content.title: Career-path content
content.description: The job titles and the state of each one's path: upload the title file, review the result, then set it ready so its holders see it and are asked to acknowledge it.
content.noMatches: No titles match the search and filters.

shown.draft: Draft: the employee does not see it

content.loadFailed: The titles could not be loaded.

actions.draft: Set the path back to draft
actions.reopen: Reopen the acknowledgement for its holders ({{count}})

preview.title: Career-path preview: {{name}}
preview.ready: This is what the title's holders see.
preview.draft: Draft: the employee does not see it until you set it ready.
preview.empty: This title has no content yet. Upload the title file to see the preview.
preview.failed: The content could not be loaded.

ready.title: Set the path of «{{name}}» ready
ready.description: The path will be shown to the title's holders ({{count}}) and they will be asked to acknowledge it. It cannot be set ready with a part missing.
ready.done: The path is ready and its holders see it.
ready.failed: The path could not be set ready: a part is missing.

draft.title: Set the path of «{{name}}» back to draft
draft.description: The path disappears for the title's holders ({{count}}) until you set it ready again. Nothing they acknowledged is deleted.
draft.done: The path is a draft again.
draft.failed: The path could not be set back to draft.

reopen.title: Reopen the acknowledgement
reopen.description: The title's holders ({{count}}) will be asked to acknowledge their path again when they sign in, and cannot use the platform before.
reopen.reasonShort: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.
reopen.done: The acknowledgement was reopened for {{count}} employees.
reopen.failed: The acknowledgement could not be reopened.

file.title: Upload the title file: {{name}}
file.description: One file per title: the job description, the career development, the learning plan and the required actions. Nothing is saved before you review it.
file.hint: txt, docx or pdf. The file is read in the browser.
file.paste: Or paste the text of the file
file.extractFailed: The text could not be read. Try again.
file.clean: Every part is sound and can be saved.
file.needsReview: Parts that need review before saving:
file.ignored: The reader skipped text that is not content: {{lines}}.
file.saveRefused: The file was not saved: it needs review.
file.saveFailed: The file could not be saved.

readErrors.unsupported: This file type is not supported: use txt, docx or pdf.
readErrors.unreadable: The file could not be read. Try pasting its text.

problems.current_title_unmarked: The career ladder has no current title marked
problems.path_steps_missing: The steps of the level path are missing
problems.transition_rule_missing: The condition to move up is missing
problems.competencies_missing: The technical competencies table is missing
problems.learning_missing: The learning plan has no units
problems.learning_total_mismatch: The total of a learning period does not match its units
problems.badges_missing: The learning plan badges are missing
problems.code_mismatch: The title code in the file is not this title's code
problems.content_invalid: Text in the file is over an allowed limit, or a duration is not understood

ai.running: The AI is reading the file… this can take a minute or two.
ai.notice: The text of the file will be sent to the AI service switched on in the settings. It holds company data, not employees' data.
ai.offer: The fixed reader could not place every part. The AI can read the file in any order and put each part in its place; you review the result before anything is saved.
ai.badge: Placed by AI: review before saving
ai.ungroundedTitle: These texts are not in the file word for word: check them before saving:

errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: No AI service is switched on in the settings.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service did not give a usable answer. Try again.
errors.TITLE_FILE_AI_RATE_LIMITED: Too many files were sent to the AI. Try again later.
errors.generic: The file could not be analysed.

saveOff.noReading: Saving opens after the file is checked («Extract») and every part is sound.
saveOff.problems: Saving is off because the file has parts that need review (listed above).

career-profile.title: Your career path
career-profile.body: Your path in your job title: the job description, evaluation, development, learning plan and what is required. At your first sign-in you read it in order, then acknowledge it.

career-content.title: Career-path content
career-content.body: Each title has its path: upload the title file, review what was read from it, then set it ready so its holders see it.

can.upload: Upload and read a title file
can.publish: Set a path ready or back to draft
can.reopen: Reopen the acknowledgement for a title's holders
can.import: Import learning-unit links from an Excel file
can.ai: Analyse a title file with AI

career-certificates.title: Certificate review
career-certificates.body: The proofs employees sent for learning units: open one, then approve it, reject it with a reason, or refer it to the direct manager.

can.reject: Reject a proof with a reason

career-team.title: My career team
career-team.body: The paths of the people under you: what they finished and what they are late in. Open a member to see what waits for your decision.

can.decide: Decide a proof referred to you

career-requests.title: Development requests
career-requests.body: The learning requests your team raises with their costs: open a request, then approve it, or reject it with a reason if it is with you.

can.reject: Reject the request with a reason

import.titleCodeHint: As in the content list (for example OPS.01.01.01-L9P-01).
import.linkHint: An https address the employee opens. Leave it empty to clear the link.
import.preview: {{updated}} units will get a new link and {{unchanged}} stay as they are.

reason.no_content: This title has no saved content
reason.period_not_found: No period of this name in the learning plan
reason.unit_not_found: No unit of this name in the period
reason.unit_ambiguous: More than one unit of this name in the period
reason.duplicate_row: The unit is named in an earlier row
reason.content_changed: The title's content changed during the import: import again

workspace.title: Career-path workspace: {{name}}
workspace.complete: Every part is complete: the path can be set ready.

problems.description: The job description is incomplete (summary, indicators or responsibilities)
problems.development: The career development is incomplete (ladder, path, competencies or the condition to move up)
problems.learning: The learning plan has no badge or no unit, or a period has no name or a repeated one
problems.required: The required actions or the acknowledgement text are incomplete

workspace.saved: The content was saved and its version went up.
workspace.stale: This title's content changed after you opened it. Close the window, open it again and redo your edit.
workspace.saveFailed: The content could not be saved. Try again.
workspace.invalid: A field of the content is missing or not valid. Fix the marked fields before saving.
workspace.evaluationNote: Performance evaluation belongs to the development stage, not to the title: the evaluation file for all stages is uploaded once from «Shared lists» when the evaluation cycle is built.
workspace.listsNote: The shared lists (stages, criteria, behaviours and the evaluation file) are built with the evaluation cycle.
workspace.saveOff: There are no changes to save. What came from a title file was saved when it was uploaded.

editor.ladderHint: Mark the employee's current title on the ladder.

discard.title: Discard the unsaved edits?

proof.sent: The proof was sent for approval.

tiles.hoursNext: Hours done · next medal: {{name}} at {{hours}} hours
tiles.competencies: Core competencies of your level met

certs.description: The proofs employees sent for the units of their learning plan: open one, then approve it (its hours count), reject it with a reason, or refer it to the direct manager.

team.noProofs: No proofs are waiting for a decision.

requests.title: Learning request
requests.description: It is approved by cost: the direct manager, then the sector head, then the CEO.
requests.planLabel: Is the course in your learning plan?
requests.planInHint: A unit of your plan that you want at another provider.
requests.planOutHint: Needs the sector head at least.
requests.agreementHint: Optional: a PDF or an image, attached for the approver to see.

requests.failed: The request could not be sent.
requests.costRequired: The cost is required (a whole number of riyals).
requests.mineEmpty: You have not sent a request yet.
